breakdown.description: For particles of the same material and shape, the finer powder has the higher specific surface area.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies and refutes the false claim that the finer powder has the lower specific surface area. It explicitly states that specific surface area is inversely proportional to particle diameter (S ∝ 1/d), calculates that the finer powder (0.5 μm) has a specific surface area 10 times greater than the coarser powder (5 μm), and concludes that 'The finer powder (0.5 μm) has the higher specific surface area.' This aligns with the ground truth prompt which asks to determine which powder has the higher specific surface area, and the correct answer is the finer powder.
